from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper as extracted from the document")
    references_other_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the other provided papers (from the collection) that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
